group.label: Catalog Events
group.comment: Keep the catalog Montu shows to ambassadors in sync: products (name, images, prices, variants, categories) and categories (Montu collections and the menu). Changes are collected and sent by the cron, never while the admin saves. Turn these on only once Montu confirms catalog sync is active for your store: an event Montu accepts counts as delivered, and unchanged products are not sent again.

field.label: Send Product Created (product.created)
field.comment: Send an event when a product is created.

field.label: Send Product Updated (product.updated)
field.comment: Send an event when a product changes: admin or API save, "Update attributes", website assignment or CSV import. A change to a variant sends its parent product.

field.label: Send Product Deleted (product.deleted)
field.comment: Send an event when a product is deleted.

field.label: Send Category Created (collection.created)
field.comment: Send an event when a category is created.

field.label: Send Category Updated (collection.updated)
field.comment: Send an event when a category changes or is moved in the tree, including its products and menu settings.

field.label: Send Category Deleted (collection.deleted)
field.comment: Send an event when a category is deleted.

field.label: Brand attribute code
field.comment: Code of the product attribute that holds each product's brand (e.g. manufacturer or marca), sent to Montu with every product. Leave empty to send no brands.
